questions.stem: What would you observe when zinc is added to copper sulfate solution?

options.text: The solution stays blue and nothing happens
The blue solution fades, a brown solid forms, and the zinc gets smaller
The solution turns green and bubbles form
The zinc dissolves and the solution turns yellow

questions.explanation: When zinc is added to copper sulfate solution, the blue colour of the solution fades (as Cu²⁺ ions are removed), a brown/orange solid (copper metal) forms on the zinc, and the zinc gets smaller as it dissolves. The solution becomes colourless as it now contains zinc sulfate.
